card: किताब पूछती है: barter system क्या है? पुराने समय में पैसे नहीं थे। लोग चीज़ के बदले चीज़ देते थे, जैसे अनाज के बदले कपड़ा। इसे barter (वस्तु-विनिमय) कहते हैं। भोला भी यही करता है!

Kitaab poochhti hai: barter system kya hai? Puraane samay mein paise nahi the. Log cheez ke badle cheez dete the, jaise anaaj ke badle kapda. Ise barter (vastu-vinimay) kehte hain. Bhola bhi yahi karta hai!
The book asks: what is the barter system? Long ago there was no money. People gave one thing for another, like grain for cloth. This is called barter. Bhola does the same!

q: exchanging one thing for another thing
exchanging one thing for another thing
The barter system means exchanging one thing for another thing, without money. It was used in old times, before money.
बार्टर का मतलब है बिना पैसे के एक चीज़ के बदले दूसरी चीज़ लेना। यह पुराने समय में, पैसे आने से पहले होता था।
Barter ka matlab hai bina paise ke ek cheez ke badle doosri cheez lena. Yeh puraane samay mein, paise aane se pehle hota tha.

card: दो वाक्यों में एक ही इंसान हो, तो उन्हें ‘who’ से जोड़ सकते हैं। ‘who’ का मतलब है ‘जो’। The girl is Sarita. The girl is wearing a red sweater. → The girl who is wearing a red sweater is Sarita.
Do vaakyon mein ek hi insaan ho, to unhe ‘who’ se jod sakte hain. ‘who’ ka matlab hai ‘jo’. The girl is Sarita. The girl is wearing a red sweater. → The girl who is wearing a red sweater is Sarita.
When two sentences are about the same person, join them with ‘who’. The girl is Sarita. The girl is wearing a red sweater. → The girl who is wearing a red sweater is Sarita.
याद रखो: ‘who’ लोगों के लिए है। जानवरों और चीज़ों के लिए ‘which’ लगाते हैं: The dog which barks is mine.
Yaad rakho: ‘who’ logon ke liye hai. Jaanwaron aur cheezon ke liye ‘which’ lagaate hain: The dog which barks is mine.
Remember: ‘who’ is for people. For animals and things we use ‘which’: The dog which barks is mine.

card: ‘should’ का मतलब ‘चाहिए’। We should plant trees = हमें पेड़ लगाने चाहिए। ‘should not’ = नहीं चाहिए। We should not waste water.
‘should’ ka matlab ‘chahiye’. We should plant trees = Humein ped lagaane chahiye. ‘should not’ = nahi chahiye. We should not waste water.
‘Should’ tells us what is right to do. We should plant trees. ‘Should not’ tells us what not to do. We should not waste water.
